tasks.label: Build and Run C++ (C++14 Mode)
tasks.command:
if string match -rq -i '\.(c|cpp|cc|cxx|c\+\+)$' '${file}'; set_color blue; echo "[1/3] Checking file: ${fileBasename}..."; set_color yellow; echo "[2/3] Compiling C++14 with flags & sanitizers..."; set_color normal; cd '${fileDirname}' && rm -f '${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bin' && g++ -std=c++14 -O2 -march=native -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wunused -Wconversion -Wfloat-equal -Wlogical-op -Wduplicated-cond -D_GLIBCXX_DEBUG -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer '${file}' -o '${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bin'; and begin; set_color green; echo "[3/3] Running program..."; set_color normal; ./'${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bin'; set exit_code $status; set_color cyan; printf "
Process exited with code: %d (0x%X)
" $exit_code $exit_code; set_color normal; end; else; set_color red; echo "[-] Error: '${fileBasename}' is not a C/C++ source file!"; set_color normal; end
